references.text: The incense altar and its use in the sanctuary, providing background for the incense offering ritual on the Day of Atonement
The recipe for the holy incense to be used before the Lord
The description of the mercy seat (kapporet) which is above the testimony (the ark of the covenant)
Moses places the incense altar and burns fragrant incense on it
Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the Lord—a warning to follow the Lord's instructions carefully so as not to die
Aaron uses incense to make atonement for the people and stop the plague
The testimony (edut) in the ark of the covenant is mentioned
Prayer is compared to incense rising before the face of the Lord
Incense rises together with the prayers of the saints before God in the heavenly temple
The Most Holy Place, with the mercy seat and the ark of the covenant, is described in connection with Christ's perfect sacrifice
